title: Task Manager CLI
description: Create a command-line interface (CLI) application to manage tasks. Users should be able to add, delete, update, and list tasks from the terminal. Data should persist locally in a file.
requirements: Build using Node.js, Python, or Go
Persist task data locally using a JSON or text file
Support commands: add, delete, list, update-status
Gracefully handle invalid commands and empty values
checklist: Initialize project repository and install minimal dependencies
Implement file read and write operations for task persistence
Implement command actions: add, delete, list
Verify task updates persist correctly across command runs
